description: Core permissions for the Nibbin desktop shell. Grants the main app webview the event plugin (listen/emit) so native→UI signals work — e.g. the C6 hotkey-pause re-render (study:paused-by-hotkey) and the sign-out re-boot. Also grants the full set of shell-only IPC commands: session keychain read/write (store_session, auth_session, sign_out), Grove webview lifecycle (grove_show, grove_hide, grove_reload), and update/navigation (check_for_update, open_external). Scoped to the local main webview only; the embedded Grove webview loads remote content and gets a separate capability (grove-remote.json) — none of these auth/session commands are in that capability.
